principalStatement: Authorize S2 successor remediation to implement and offline-qualify the exact 20-case/103-repetition measured driver, then bind it and its receipt into a successor preregistration. This does not authorize live preflight or measured S2 execution.
authorizedActions: implement one successor measured S2 driver for the accepted 20-case and 103-repetition corpus
implement and run offline-only driver-control qualification
retain failed driver and harness candidates if any
bind the exact driver, dependency closure, and passing offline receipt into one successor preregistration candidate
produce a successor readiness receipt and review document
notAuthorized: edit accepted preregistration candidate 2 or any artifact bound by it
invoke the deterministic stub through OpenHands
start or restart Agent Canvas, agent-server, SMA, MongoDB, or Qdrant
create a measured MongoDB database, Qdrant collection, workspace, or output root
run any measured S2 case or repetition
